Hi Olivia / Tom —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Sunnyside live. Attached is a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the canary evaluation plan we discussed. High-level proposal below (we kept to sprint-sized milestones so you can validate in production quickly):

- Sprint 0 (Week 1): Provisioning + infra validation (private endpoint, VPC peering, KMS key exchange).
- Sprint 1 (Week 2): Canary cohort (5% traffic, limited flows) + nightly regression evals.
- Sprint 2 (Week 3): Expand to 30% with training sessions for CS and Support (two 60-min sessions).
- Sprint 3 (Week 4): Full cutover, migration of historical routing, and acceptance runbook.

Evaluation plan highlights (see canary_test_plan.pdf):
- Latency SLA target: p95 < 420ms for critical routes.
- Quality gates: BLEU/ROUGE threshold on templated responses + hand-annotated sample of 200 prompts.
- Regression alerting: daily quality drift check + rollback triggers.

Open asks for you to confirm so we can lock dates in our calendar:
1) Preferred canary start date (we proposed 2027-09-12 in sheet).
2) Two training session slots (week of 9/19) and attendee list.
3) Procurement contact for invoicing and PO reference.

Attachments: sunnyside_MAP_v3.xlsx (master MAP), canary_test_plan.pdf (test cases + metrics), training_cadence.ics (proposed sessions).

If that looks good I’ll file the DocuSign handoffs and loop in engineering for provisioning.

Thanks,
— Soojin
